sections.t: Upper B done with a 46-minute lifting session, plus about 3.0 km of running at 8:56/km, right on the easy target. That completes all four lifting sessions and both easy runs planned this week.
Long run: 3.3 km, the week 1 distance and within 10% of your 3.0 km longest run in the past 30 days. Start slower than feels natural and aim for 8:45-9:15/km, walking briefly if breathing gets hard.

Have some easy carbs 1 to 2 hours before the run, such as Protein overnight oats or a Skyr berry bowl. Afterwards, a Chicken and potato tray bake helps refuel and keeps you on track for 1,750 kcal and 130 g protein.
